_doc: D3-01 P5 heist casts, extended in D-115 to the four pre-P5 heists (ENV D). heist -> role -> [character ids]; each id's scene is res://world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn (characters.json lists them). P5 roles are generic names; the D-115 heists (glasshouse, night_deposit, dockside_burn, shadow_ledger) are keyed by the spawn tags in the design doc's roster table (docs/design/heists/<heist>.md, '### ... roster (spawn data)'), so ENV A's NpcVisualTweak.heist_tag_characters can mirror them 1:1; the camera operator is security_operator (CAMERA_OPERATOR spawn) and 'police' is the director's police roster. Reused ids are D1/D2 characters cast again (D-063 reserved the tellers, guests and waitress for P5). Faction-variant ids (<id>_frd|_sentinel|_zero) are picked per difficulty by EnemyDef.params.visual_variant (characters.md v1.6), so only the base ids are listed. pager_roles lists the P5 pager roles only. Hand-maintained by ENV D; checked by game/tests/d/test_p5_cast.gd.

notes.gallery_night: Halberd Gallery Security is the gallery's in-house guard (bottle-green blazer, Halberd crest), not Halden or Northgate. The curator is the keycard carrier and the one pale suit at the gala.
notes.ostrander_federal: Ostrander Federal (D-075). Tellers keep the D2-02 bank livery and the new day manager (keycard carrier) matches it; the gallery-level loan/accounts officers (D-075) wear grey suits with the bank's red lanyard and ID badge. Guards are Halden Security: the day officers (peaked cap) and the bare-headed night guard (camera operator). civilian_customer_b is the elderly customer; bank_customer_b is the parent with a backpack.
notes.rolling_thunder: The crew works for Vaultline Armored Transport (original). The escort is the police/TAC roster plus its frd/sentinel/zero reskins by difficulty; no new escort model.
notes.afterhours: Staff wear black and the Velvet's violet; patrons are mixed club wear. club_bouncer_b's Hip/Socket is on a belt radio; club_bouncer's is the default hip seat (radio under the bomber is not modelled).
notes.glasshouse: Golden Hour (D-115). Guards and the operator are Halden. Greta Vossberg (owner/manager, rare nervous_manager) is civilian_manager_vossberg; the two associates are told apart (civilian_sales at the counter, civilian_sales_b on the floor); the upstairs admin clerk wears civilian_clerk office wear, not the shop-floor dress. Customers add the Ostrander bank_customer looks for variety. Guard tags and the operator are not in the roster table: they come from the guard_post variant table and the CameraOperatorSeat spawn.
notes.night_deposit: Nightfall Depository (D-115). Halden on the floor; the seated operator is the bare-headed Halden night guard (npc_bank_guard). The night manager (code carrier) is npc_bank_night_manager (bank livery, D2-02). The armored_car_early guards are the Vaultline crew (guard_armored_car, from the rare-event table, not the roster).
notes.dockside_burn: Dockside Burn (D-115). Co-op cartel gunmen on every cartel post (EnemyDef enemy.cartel_gunman visual_alternates); night-shift workers are the dock crew (forklift drivers dock_worker/_b, the packer dock_packer), never bank staff. Police are the director roster plus faction reskins.
notes.shadow_ledger: Shadow Ledger (D-115). Every guard and the operator are Northgate Executive Protection (npc_northgate_guard/_b), never Halden. Cleaners wear the Calder tabard on both floors: npc_cleaner_sl (man, buzz cut) and npc_cleaner_sl_b (D-SL-2: woman, late 50s, grey bun), same uniform, two faces so the Brutal cleaners are not twins. Helena Moor is npc_helena_moor, Victor Kessler npc_kessler (robe).
